title: Woman dies in Chilliwack, B.C., jail
article: A 26-year-old woman has died after being held over the weekend in a jail cell in Chilliwack, B.C..
The RCMP say Laura Eileen Coward was arrested last Friday on an outstanding warrant for breach of probation and assault.
She was taken to hospital later the same day to be treated for an existing medical condition before being returned to jail.
On Monday, she was found unresponsive when guards went to her cell to take her to a court appearance.
CPR was started on Coward and an ambulance was called, but she was pronounced dead at the scene.
Police say they're investigating what caused the death and the circumstances surrounding her arrest and time in jail.
